in_hebrew.name: Marji
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Lady of Magdala

This name has strong biblical connections, as Marja, Mary Magdalene, was a prominent follower of Jesus Christ in the New Testament. She is remembered for her faith, devotion, and loyalty to Jesus, making this name an excellent choice for parents seeking to instill these virtues in their child.
